name: Synergix ERP
description_en:
Synergix ERP is a modular business system with manufacturing and project-costing solutions described by Synergix Technologies. The manufacturing path links demand, BOMs, purchasing, capacity and execution; the project path adds phased budgets, variations, claims and retention.

These are related module scopes, not proof every function is in one basic package. This profile did not run a project or factory, validate a Singapore accounting requirement or determine grant eligibility. Prices remain quote-based, with no invented monetary amount.
description_zh:
Synergix ERP 是 Synergix Technologies 的模块化业务系统，提供制造及项目成本方案。制造路径连接需求、物料清单、采购、产能和执行，项目路径增加分期预算、变更、款项申请及保留款。

这些属于关联模块范围，不证明基础套餐包含全部。本文未运行项目工厂、验证新加坡会计要求或判断补助资格；价格按询价处理，不编造金额。

core_features.explanation_en: MRP combines orders/backorders/minimum stock, flags shortages and raises requisitions before approved purchase orders.
core_features.explanation_zh: MRP 结合订单欠单最低库存，识别缺料并先请购审批再发采购单。

core_features.explanation_en: Record actual material, machine time, overhead quantities and accepted/rejected output against planned figures.
core_features.explanation_zh: 记录实际物料、机器时间、间接费用数量及合格拒绝产出，与计划对照。

core_features.name_zh: 分期项目成本及保留款

core_features.explanation_zh: 项目成本连接预算、采购工时费用、变更和保留款计费。

sections.title_en: Trace a shortage through approval into production
sections.title_zh: 把缺料沿审批追踪至生产
sections.en:
The manufacturing page describes multilevel BOMs with revisions, demand from sales/forecasts, work-center capacity and shortage requisitions routed for approval before PO release. Execution captures actual usage and accepted/rejected quantities for variance reports.

For a hypothetical batch, change the BOM revision and introduce a shortage, then inspect purchase approval and the released work order. Compare actual consumption, machine time and output. This is an acceptance example, not a factory test or proof that all urgent-order rescheduling is feasible.
sections.zh:
制造页介绍多层修订 BOM、销售预测需求、工作中心产能，以及缺料请购经审批后发采购单；执行阶段记录实际使用和合格拒绝数量用于差异报表。

可假设一个批次，修改 BOM 版本并加入缺料，再检查采购审批及释放工单，对照实际耗料、机器时间和产出。这是验收例子，不是工厂实测，也不证明所有急单重排都可行。

sections.title_en: A project claim is different from manufacturing output
sections.title_zh: 项目款项申请与制造产出不同
sections.en:
The project page describes phase/sub-phase resource budgets, procurement/time/employee-claim cost allocation, budget revisions, variation audit trails and retention billing. It also offers mobile-browser workflows for supervisors and approvers.

Evaluate a project phase with an approved variation and a partial claim: compare budget, incurred cost, billed amount and retention separately. Do not equate an estimated margin with collected cash. The page’s claim of conformity with accounting standards is vendor wording, not an independent legal/accounting conclusion from this profile.
sections.zh:
项目页介绍阶段子阶段资源预算、采购工时员工费用分摊、预算修订、变更审计和保留款计费，并为主管审批人提供手机浏览器流程。

可评估带已批准变更及部分款项申请的项目阶段，分别对照预算、发生成本、开票和保留款，不能把预计毛利等同收款。页面关于会计标准的表述属于厂商主张，不是本文独立法律会计结论。

sections.title_en: Vertical add-ons must be quoted explicitly
sections.title_zh: 行业附加模块需明确报价
sections.en:
The manufacturing page lists subcontract management, additional resource planning, QA/QC and barcode/RFID integration outside its basic manufacturing solution. The project page separately lists claims/certification, MRP, payroll/leave and time-card/barcode integrations as extensions. Shared navigation does not make them all included.

Ask the demo to show the exact base and optional modules, interface/hardware requirements and authority to approve changes. The current FAQs describe AI drafting for human review; no AI accuracy or automatic financial authorization was tested. No future-upgrade compatibility guarantee was independently adopted.
sections.zh:
制造页把外协、额外资源规划、QA/QC 和条码 RFID 集成列在基础制造方案之外；项目页另将款项认证、MRP、薪资休假和考勤条码等列作扩展。共用导航不能使它们全部包含。

演示应明确基础与可选模块、接口硬件要求及审批权。当前 FAQ 介绍 AI 起草后由人工复核，但本文未测试准确性或自动财务授权，也未独立采用未来升级兼容保证。

sections.title_en: Scope the quotation and the implementation owner
sections.title_zh: 明确报价和实施负责人
sections.en:
The manufacturing FAQ read on 22 October 2026 explicitly says pricing is quote-based on modules, users and customization. No numeric license amount or currency was established. The official contact route offers sales consultation. Public grant references do not establish this buyer’s eligibility or a discounted net cost.

Prepare BOM/routes, resource calendars, opening stock/WIP or project budgets/retention balances, plus roles and migration scope. Test a rejected approval, late timesheet, partial return and corrected claim in a scoped demonstration. Actual deployment/license terms, statutory coverage, integration behavior, export/retention and recovery remain unverified. No contact request, trial or migration was executed.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的制造 FAQ 明确按模块、用户和定制询价，未确立数字许可费或币种；官方联系入口提供销售咨询。公开补助提法不能证明本买家资格或减免后净成本。

应准备物料路线、资源日历、期初库存在制或项目预算保留款，以及角色迁移范围。在明确范围演示中测试拒绝审批、迟报工时、部分退回及更正款项申请。部署许可、法定覆盖、集成、导出保留及恢复仍未核实；未提交咨询、执行试用迁移。
